appearance_facts.fact: The chart title reads: 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'.
The y-axis is labeled 'Number of Tourists' with tick marks at 0, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, and 3000, and an upper limit of 3500.
The x-axis is labeled 'Year' and spans from 1880 to 1891.
A blue line chart plots the number of new tourists over time, showing fluctuations between 1000 and over 3000.
The line starts at 1000 in 1880, rises to a peak near 2500 around 1886-1887, dips to a low around 2200 in 1888, and then rises sharply to over 3000 by 1891.
